OWNERSHIP | CanvasHistory.record [canvasHistory.ts]
CanvasHistoryRecord
  |-- canvasViews?: CanvasViews [canvasView.ts]
  |    |-- saved[viewId] -> CanvasView metadata
  |    |    |-- checkpointIds: saved route through time
  |    |    |-- start/final: pinned comparison endpoints
  |    |    `-- parentViewId/forkCheckpointId: ancestry
  |    |-- recording?: named capture in progress
  |    |-- activeViewId: current saved identity
  |    `-- workingCopies[viewId] -> checkpoint id
  |         retains local edits when switching away
  |-- snapshots[id] -> StoredCanvasSnapshot
  |    |-- document: canvas composition and anchors
  |    |-- diagramBindings[diagramId] -> revision id
  |    `-- view: personal restoration data
  |-- diagramRevisions[id] -> diagram bytes
  `-- headId/past/future: undo navigation
       named views sit outside restored snapshots
